aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6:cli:.policyDescription: Allows access to restart and stop DDA greengrass components
Allows access to list and get details for greengrass components on device

aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6:shad.policyDescription: Allows access to things with shadows

aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6:mqtt.policyDescription: Allows access to shadow pubsub topics

Allows workflow mqtt_publish output publishes: the node topic parameter is free-form user input, so no topic prefix can cover it and publish must be authorized on the wildcard resource. Deliberately publish-only; SubscribeToIoTCore is NOT broadened beyond the shadow topics in mqttproxy:1

ComponentDescription: DDA Local Web Server App - ARM64 JetPack 6

Install.Script:
docker images --quiet --filter=dangling=true | xargs --no-run-if-empty docker rmi -f || true; docker load -i {artifacts:decompressedPath}/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6-aarch64/custom-build/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6/flask-app.tar && docker load -i {artifacts:decompressedPath}/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6-aarch64/custom-build/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6/react-webapp.tar
chmod +x {artifacts:decompressedPath}/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6-aarch64/custom-build/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6/host_scripts/*.sh
bash {artifacts:decompressedPath}/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6-aarch64/custom-build/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6/host_scripts/install_nvidia_csi_service.sh

Shutdown.Script:
systemctl stop nvidia-csi-capture || true
export $(grep -v '^#' /tmp/.dda.env | xargs) || true
docker compose --profile ${DOCKER_PROFILE:-tegra} -f {artifacts:decompressedPath}/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6-aarch64/custom-build/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6/docker-compose.yaml down
bash {artifacts:decompressedPath}/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6-aarch64/custom-build/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6/host_scripts/compose_lifecycle.sh wait-empty 240 -- --profile ${DOCKER_PROFILE:-tegra} -f {artifacts:decompressedPath}/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6-aarch64/custom-build/aws.edgeml.dda.LocalServer.arm64JP6/docker-compose.yaml || true
